study_design: Prospective nested case-control study using prediagnostic serum from a cohort blood bank; 61 incident prostate cancer cases were matched to two controls each.
reason: The abstract evaluates subsequent incident prostate cancer overall. Although it mentions men with "more severe disease," it does not define or clearly report a separate aggressive, advanced, high-grade, metastatic, or lethal incidence endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: We studied sera obtained from 61 residents who were diagnosed with prostate cancer during the period 1980 through 1992.
estimate_classifications.reason: This row concerns prediagnostic serum vitamin D metabolite levels and overall incident prostate cancer; no separately defined aggressive endpoint is established.
